title: No CI/CD workflows: nothing runs typecheck, lint, unit tests, rules tests or build before deploy
impact: `.github/` contains only ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ and PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md. Current state would fail CI anyway: ESLint reports 441 problems (246 errors) per 00-baseline.md and test:security has 1 failing test. CONTRIBUTING.md:L36-L38 and L53 require tests but nothing enforces it.
recommendation: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml: node 22, `npm ci`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint` (non-blocking until errors fixed, then blocking), `npm test`, `npm run test:security` (needs Java for emulators), `npm run build`, plus `cd functions && npm ci && npm run build`. Add dependabot.yml.

title: Deploy path is implicit and ambiguous (Firebase Hosting webframeworks vs Vercel artefacts)
impact: firebase.json hosting has `source: "."` + frameworksBackend (us-central1); README.md 'Deployment' says `npm run build && firebase deploy`; yet package.json has `vercel` CLI (L90), @vercel/analytics and .gitignore ignores .vercel. No documented environments (staging/prod), .firebaserc has only `default: scorpio-srs`, no predeploy for hosting (only functions build), no rules/tests gate before `firebase deploy`.
recommendation: Document the single supported deploy path, add `.firebaserc` aliases (staging/prod), add predeploy `npm run test && tsc --noEmit`, and remove the Vercel artefacts if unused.

title: No pre-commit hooks, formatter, editorconfig, typecheck script, or Node version pin
impact: No husky/lint-staged/prettier, no .prettierrc/.editorconfig/.nvmrc, no `engines` field (00-baseline.md: Node v24 used, functions requires 22), and no `typecheck` script. Formatting is inconsistent (e.g. tests/security files are minified single lines). `npm run lint` is plain `eslint` with 441 existing problems.
recommendation: Add prettier + eslint-config-prettier, husky + lint-staged (eslint --fix, prettier), `"typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"`, `engines.node: ">=22"` and .nvmrc.

title: README setup/stack info is partly wrong or incomplete
impact: L4 badge says TypeScript 5.7 (repo uses 5.9.3, package.json:L113); L174 documents a `scripts/` folder that does not exist (tools/migrate-school-security.cjs is the only script dir); README never mentions .env.example, `functions/` install (`cd functions && npm ci`), Java/Firebase emulators, `npm run test:security`, or Node 22 for functions (README L200 says Node 20+, functions need 22); env block (L215-L238) omits POLAR_PRODUCT_ID and recaptcha/App Check vars; it describes mathlive (unused) and 'Gemini 3.8 Flash' model names unverifiable; footer says 2025.
recommendation: Rewrite Quick Start: prerequisites (Node 22, Java 17+, firebase-tools), `cp .env.example .env.local`, `npm ci`, `cd functions && npm ci`, emulator instructions, test commands; fix the project-structure block and badges.

title: Env vars used in code but missing from .env.example (POLAR_PRODUCT_ID, NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_PROVIDER, NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APPCHECK_DEBUG_TOKEN)
impact: Diff of `process.env.*` in src/functions/tools vs .env.example names (raw/env-diff-missing-from-example.txt): missing POLAR_PRODUCT_ID (checkout route L37, L40; checkout silently has undefined product for both plans), NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_PROVIDER (src/lib/firebase.ts:L38), NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APPCHECK_DEBUG_TOKEN (firebase.ts:L24-L29); platform/test vars (NODE_ENV, GCLOUD_PROJECT, *_EMULATOR_HOST, SCORPIO_BUILD_DIR) are fine to omit but SCORPIO_BUILD_DIR (next.config.mjs:L4) should be documented. Reverse: .env.example defines NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_CLIENT_ID (L14) which no code reads. Values were not read or printed.
recommendation: Add the missing names to .env.example with comments; remove NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_CLIENT_ID; add a startup env validation (zod) listing required vars.

impact: check_portfolios.ts (434 B, imports ./src/lib/firebase-admin: a prod-DB debugging script, tracked) -> move to tools/ or delete; update_mermaid.py (3 KB, rewrites README diagrams) -> tools/ or delete; demo.md (6.8 KB video script) -> docs/; diagram.mermaid (2.3 KB) -> docs/ (README embeds the diagram already); opencode.json (335 B, tool config pointing at CONTRIBUTING.md/LAYERING.MD) -> keep only if team uses opencode, else delete; UIAUDIT.MD (12 KB) -> docs/audits/; LAYERING.MD (4 KB) -> docs/architecture.md (referenced by opencode.json). Also uppercase `.MD` extensions are non-standard.

title: Repo is 257 MB; binary media committed in history, many superseded versions, no Git LFS
impact: `du -sh .git` = 257M. Largest blobs (raw/git-large-objects.txt): assignment-creation-teacher.mp4 30.8 MB, student-submission-math-file.mp4 27.3 MB, scorpio-demo.mp4 22.5 MB, scorpio-demo.webm 21.0 MB, navigation-assistant.mp4 20.6 MB, scorpio-demo-orig.mp4 20.2 MB, a root-level ai-tutor-chat.mp4 19.4 MB, landing-demo.webm 18.9 MB, landing-demo-v2.webm 17.8 MB ... Each iteration of a demo video adds permanently to clone time. No .gitattributes/LFS.
recommendation: Stop committing videos: host on Storage/CDN or use Git LFS (`git lfs track 'public/demos/*.{mp4,webm}'`); optionally rewrite history with git-filter-repo (coordinate with collaborators) to purge the ~250 MB of superseded media.

title: Commit history mixes conventional commits and free-form/vague messages; no enforcement
impact: Of the 40 most recent subjects, roughly half use `feat:`/`fix(scope):` while others are 'sustainability', 'optimized home page', 'ai updates', 'full ui restack', 'dashboard + page fixes post ui', and one 300-char message ('Implemented the fixes locally: authentication, school isolation ...') bundling many security changes. 360 commits, no tags.
recommendation: Adopt Conventional Commits with commitlint (husky commit-msg hook) and squash-merge PRs with titles; tag releases.

title: CHANGELOG is stale: single v0.1.0 (2026-02-20) entry vs 360 commits; version 0.1.0 unmeaningful
impact: CHANGELOG.md is 549 bytes, one entry. Meanwhile major work (security migration, billing change, rebrand to Raise, Gemini model migration) happened with no entries. package.json:L3 version is 0.1.0, git has no tags.
recommendation: Either automate (release-please / changesets using conventional commits) or delete the file; bump version and tag on releases, document breaking security migration in the changelog.

title: Functions have a separate lockfile/toolchain with no bootstrap docs; TypeScript 5.7.3 vs 5.9.3 at root, Node 22 vs undeclared root
impact: functions/ has its own package-lock.json and tsconfig; root `npm ci` does not install it (00-baseline.md: EBADENGINE under Node 24). A clean clone following README cannot build functions/predeploy. firebase-functions is ^7.0.0 in functions and ^7.2.2 in root (unused).
recommendation: Add `postinstall`/npm workspaces or a `setup` script; align TypeScript versions; document in README.

title: Positive: governance docs and deployment notes exist
impact: CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, SUPPORT.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, LICENSE (MIT), PR/issue templates and docs/school-deployment-readiness.md (linked from README) exist; .gitignore correctly ignores .env*, service-account*.json, firestore-debug.log, tsbuildinfo (verified with git check-ignore; none of these are tracked).

title: Local app cannot run against Firebase Emulators: client SDK lacks connect*Emulator calls, firebase.test.json omits Auth emulator, and firebase-admin.ts rejects dummy .env.example keys
impact: Grep for connect.*Emulator across src/ finds 0 matches (src/lib/firebase.ts:L62-L64 connects directly to production Auth/Firestore/Storage, and L32-L44 initializes ReCaptchaEnterpriseProvider with a hardcoded prod key). firebase.json has no emulators config and firebase.test.json:L1 only configures firestore and storage (no auth). On the server, src/lib/firebase-admin.ts:L25-L44 requires FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL and calls admin.credential.cert() even when FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST is set, failing with `Invalid PEM formatted message` on .env.example's dummy FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY. Consequently, authenticated pages (/student, /teacher) cannot be run or audited locally with emulators without editing app code.
recommendation: Add an `emulators` block (auth, firestore, storage) to firebase.json, wire connectAuthEmulator/connectFirestoreEmulator/connectStorageEmulator in src/lib/firebase.ts when NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=true, and initialize firebase-admin without credential.cert() when FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST or FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST is set.

title: Clean-clone execution of README Quick Start & Deployment fails on functions/ build (TS2307 missing modules, EBADENGINE on Node 24) and npm run test:security (exit code 1)
impact: Executing README.md Quick Start literally in a clean clone (/tmp/scorpio-clean-clone, raw/clean-clone-log.txt) with `cp .env.example .env.local`: `npm install` (15s, 97 vulns), `npm test` (39/39 pass), and `npm run build` (passes in 73s after 20 font read ETIMEDOUT retries) succeed at root. However: (1) `cd functions && npm run build` (triggered by `firebase deploy` predeploy in firebase.json:L53) fails with exit code 2 (`TS2307: Cannot find module '@google/genai'`, `'resend'`, `'@react-email/components'`) because README omits `cd functions && npm ci`; (2) `cd functions && npm ci` warns `EBADENGINE required: { node: '22' }, current: { node: 'v24.12.0' }`; and (3) `npm run test:security` exits with code 1 (workflows.test.ts:L60 fails 0.45 !== 0.28 + JDK 24 sun.misc.Unsafe warning).
recommendation: Add `cd functions && npm ci` to README Quick Start (or a root postinstall script), add .nvmrc pinning Node 22, document Java + emulator prerequisites for `npm run test:security`, and fix the failing budget settlement test.
